references.text: The first tribal leader, Nahshon from Judah, brought exactly the same gifts: a silver plate weighing 130 shekels and a silver bowl weighing 70 shekels according to the sanctuary weight, both filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.
Nethanel from Issachar brought identical gifts as Pagiel from Asher: a silver plate, a silver bowl of the same weight, and fine flour mixed with oil.
The plates and bowls used in the tabernacle were made of pure gold, and this verse describes similar holy vessels for service in the sanctuary.
The shekel of the sanctuary is mentioned here as the standard for weighing, the same standard used to weigh the silver gifts in Numbers 7:55.
The grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil is described in detail here and is the same type of offering that the tribal leaders brought in their silver plates.
Pagiel from Asher's full list of offerings begins here, and verse 55 describes his silver vessels and grain offering as part of his dedication gift.
